headline: Sky's USDS Stablecoin Shrinks 35% as $1.5B Exits Reserves After Illicit-Finance Report
summary: Sky's USDS stablecoin contracted by 35% after $1.5 billion left its reserves following an illicit-finance report. The stablecoin held its $1 peg despite large withdrawals of USDC liquidity backing it.
why: Sky, formerly known as MakerDAO, is one of the largest decentralized finance protocols, and changes in its reserves test stablecoin stability and DeFi liquidity.

impacts.name: USDS
impacts.why: USDS circulating supply dropped 35% as $1.5 billion was withdrawn from the protocol's backing reserves.
